field order: the order of `message fields`; forwarded, the semantic check value and authentication may be absent, and the integrity check value is required on every message that carries an operative or a pending move and on every protocol message
first entry: the number, in the sender's count of its own entries from one, of the entry the message's first move adds; the k-th move adds the entry numbered first entry + k - 1 (protocol 0.2)
envelope: a unit with its own count and check word, the fields from the sender to the semantic check value inside it, and the authentication and the integrity check value after it (protocol 0.3)
protocol message: a message whose identifier and first entry are zero, which takes no serial on its channel and adds no entry, carries one statement in place of moves, has one recipient and carries the integrity check value (protocol 0.3)

unit check word.applies to: the envelope and the statement of a protocol message
unit check word.rule: each word between the unit's count and its check word, at position i from 0, adds its code times (i mod 10) + 1, a member's own code before its class's, and a word with neither adds 0; the sum modulo 11 is written as the number check word of that value

authentication: the signature covers the canonical serialisation of the message without its authentication and integrity check value fields; the integrity check value covers the signature

features.name: act words
features.reason: a word that stands for force values

features.name: idioms
features.reason: an expression whose meaning is its entry's expansion

features.name: declared losses
features.reason: a record of the social and textual component, which the normal form sets aside

features.name: registers
features.reason: two registers make a move precision-bound

features.name: politeness words
features.reason: a record of the social and textual component, in a move's head

features.name: dictions
features.reason: a record of the social and textual component, in a move's head; a diction written as a term's content word is content, which a reader lacking it keeps opaque

features.name: conventional senses
features.reason: a sense shares its root's form, so a reader lacking it would read the root literally

features.name: authentication
features.reason: the integrity check value covers the signature, so a reader that passes over it still tells damage; it verifies nothing, as a reader without the sender's key

features.name: dialects
features.reason: a dialect form means its expansion only to a reader holding its dialect

feature rule: a word belongs to a feature by its class, its own identifier or the grammatical category of its lexicon entry, and a conventional sense where a frame selects it; a reader lacking a may-ignore feature passes over its words in a move's head and keeps a word of it standing as content opaque, and a reader lacking a must-understand feature rejects every move that uses it

maxima.rule: the least values that admit every item of the conformance corpus, the attitude items, the adversarial messages and the ambiguity test set, in normal expression and in full explicitness; every register declares these in protocol 0.5
